changelog: Say "shorten my text" or "make it concise" — or "ছোট করো" in Bengali — alone while dictating in WhatsApp or Messenger and the whole dictated message is rewritten shorter and more concisely through Gemini with your own key. Gboard's Pixel 9+ writing-tools "Shorten" command, the third writing-tools rewrite after "fix it" and "formalize" — the fix for a message dictated long and rambling. Keeps every fact, name and number and your tone; only repetition and filler are cut.
